The key case facts from White v. Carmichael Industries involve a dispute over the termination of Ms. White’s contract. Ms. White alleges that her termination was unlawful retaliation for whistleblowing on environmental violations, while the defendant, Carmichael Industries, claims the termination was due to organizational restructuring and unrelated to her allegations. The major legal points center on the claim of whistleblower retaliation and the determination of the true motive behind the employment termination.

The organ that pumps blood is the heart.
